head: Pilot Live Map: tap a plane overhead to see where it's going
dek: Pilot is a live map of planes, nearby emergency incidents from official services and space stations, worldwide; spot a plane and look it up with a tap. It was #56 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 5 November.
details: Aircraft positions update every 10 seconds. It costs $0.29 with in-app purchases, by Joseph Schubert.
means: If you like knowing which plane is flying over you, this does it for under a dollar.
todo: Find Pilot Live Map in the App Store.
